summary.text: James Skoufis is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 42 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Skoufis served in the New York State Assembly from 2013 to 2019 and has been a state senator since 2019; he is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: James Skoufis attended Monroe-Woodbury High School, earned a B.A. from George Washington University in 2008 and an M.A. from Columbia University in 2009.
His professional experience includes working as a project manager at Amerigard Alarm and Security Corporation.
Skoufis represented Assembly District 99 from 2013 to 2019, succeeding Steve Katz (R), and has served in the State Senate since 2019.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Investigations and Government Operations Committee and is assigned to the Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Judiciary; Finance; Insurance; Labor; and Local Government committees.
On November 30, 2024, Skoufis announced a campaign for chairman of the Democratic National Committee, and he withdrew from that race on January 16, 2025.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Skoufis faces Jennifer Figueroa (R) and Joshua Blumenthal (Conservative Party).
